verdict.rationale: Dagster documents an official Dagster+ MCP server that lets an AI session access information and take actions in a Dagster+ deployment, and a probe confirms the dedicated docs page exists. The evidence is a single descriptive sentence, and it appears tied to Dagster+ rather than OSS. Missing for 10: detail on setup, auth and exposed tools; evidence of support for self-hosted OSS deployments; independent or hands-on corroboration.
